name: Valentino Park, Turin
description: Motor racing came to the public roads of Turin's riverside park between 1935 and 1955, under the name Gran Premio del Valentino. The 1946 running was the first race held to the new Formula One regulations, and the Italian Grand Prix itself came here in 1948. The 1955 meeting was the last: Sergio Mantovani crashed his Maserati in practice and lost a leg, and the city never raced in the park again.
author: ZOSO666
